definitions.explanation: Protecting or caring for someone (especially a child) to an excessive degree, to the point where it hinders their independence or growth. Almost always carries a negative or critical nuance.

examples.japanese: うちの{親|おや}は{過保護|かほご}だ。
{過保護|かほご}に{育|そだ}てると、{子供|こども}の{自立|じりつ}が{遅|おく}れる。
examples.english: If you raise children in an overprotective way, their independence will be delayed.

examples.japanese: {心配|しんぱい}する{気持|きも}ちは{分|わ}かるが、あまり{過保護|かほご}にするのもよくない。
examples.english: I understand the feeling of worry, but being too overprotective isn't good either.

notes:
Literally {過|か} (excessive) + {保護|ほご} (protection). Almost always used critically to describe parenting that goes too far. Can also be used as a noun.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {過保護|かほご}な{親|おや} (overprotective parent)
- {過保護|かほご}に{育|そだ}てる (to raise overprotectively)
- {過保護|かほご}にする (to be overprotective toward)

RELATED WORDS:
- {過干渉|かかんしょう} — over-interfering (more about controlling behavior than shielding)
- モンスターペアレント — monster parent (aggressive toward schools/institutions)
- ヘリコプターペアレント — helicopter parent (borrowed from English)
